detailed_description:
The target video uses a live-action, realistic style with nighttime urban street lighting and a fixed medium-wide shot.
[Shot 1] A static medium-wide shot frames seven dancers standing in a horizontal row on the asphalt pavement of <Subject 4>, the nighttime urban street with lit high-rise buildings, warm street lamps, green trees, and the blue "北海科路 / Hai Ke Rd S" sign visible in the background. From screen left to right, the row consists of: an unmarked young man in a white T-shirt and dark pants; <Subject 1>, the young woman with long straight black hair, faint freckles, a navy V-neck knit vest over a white shirt, a blue-and-white plaid pleated skirt, and black loafers; an unmarked young man in a white T-shirt and camouflage pants; an unmarked young woman at center in a white hoodie and a black-and-white plaid mini skirt with short hair; <Subject 3>, the young woman with long dark hair, a black off-shoulder cable-knit sweater, a black mini skirt, brown combat boots, black sunglasses on her head, and a small black crossbody bag; <Subject 2>, the young woman with voluminous long black hair, an oversized beige sweater with horizontal blue stripes, black shorts, and brown chunky boots; and an unmarked young man in a white T-shirt, grey shorts, and a white headband. All seven begin with their arms at their sides, then raise both hands above shoulder height with fingers spread in a synchronized motion, palms facing forward. They hold the pose for one beat, then lower their arms and cross their wrists in front of their chests while simultaneously shifting their hips to the right. On the next beat, they uncross their arms, point both index fingers diagonally upward toward the sky, and tilt their heads slightly back with open-mouthed energetic expressions. They then swing their arms down to waist height, make a small circular wrist rotation, and step their left foot outward while twisting their torsos toward screen left. Returning to center, they raise their right arms straight up with open palms while keeping their left hands on their hips, then switch sides on the following beat. Toward the final two seconds, all seven bring both hands forward in a waving gesture, take a small step forward in unison, and settle into a final relaxed pose with arms swinging naturally at their sides, facing the camera directly as the shot holds through the nine-second mark. <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3> maintain their replaced facial features, hairstyles, and full wardrobe throughout every gesture and body movement, with fabric responding naturally to the dance motion.

overall_soundscape:
The nighttime street carries a low ambient hum of distant city traffic and a faint breeze through the trees. The dancers' shoe soles make soft rhythmic taps against the asphalt, and their sweater and skirt fabrics rustle subtly with each arm and hip movement.
